name: A later trial at Thalorien’s rest

date.label: A later Wrath quest test at the remains of a Third War defender

summary: At Thalorien’s resting place, the Wrath quest sets a new seeker against a trial and a memory of the fallen knight. This encounter does not undo his death or make him a living participant in the restoration. His blessing links the blade’s old bearer to its present burden. The story holds both moments apart: Thalorien fell at the Sunwell in the Third War; a later test asks whether the seeker is worthy to carry his memory onward.
